relations_checked: rho is strictly increasing and maps r=0,1,2 to .5,1.25,2; the inner circle is r=0, not r=.5. All original coordinate labels are preserved.

The red arc is on drawn radius 1.25, hence r=1, strictly between the two boundary circles. Its increasing-angle direction agrees with theta(t)=theta0+t/a(1), since a(1)=5/2>0.
Proof 1.4 computes a'(1)=0, verifies the geodesic equations, unit speed, and periodic interior containment; the sketch asserts no metric-isometry or nullspace claim.
